name.hi: संघ लोक सेवा आयोग सिविल सेवा परीक्षा

sources.ref: Examination Notice No. 05/2026-CSE dated 04.02.2026, Civil Services Examination, 2026; publisher: Union Public Service Commission

open_questions.question: The Civil Services Examination, 2027 notice is not published yet (checked 2026-10-30). This is the latest official pattern; re-verify and version it as upsc-cse-2027 when UPSC notifies it.

The UPSC Annual Calendar 2027 (https://www.upsc.gov.in/sites/default/files/Calendar-Year-2027-Engl-200526.pdf) could not be opened from this environment (HTTP 403), so the 2027 notification and Prelims dates are not recorded.
Shift timings are not stated in the notice; they appear on the admit card.
